name: Galaxy Z Flip 7 FE

images.credit: Ssu, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.SIM: Nano-SIM + eSIM + eSIM (max 2 at a time)

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 16 with One UI 8.0, Current: Android 17 with One UI 9.0

Display.Display: Foldable Dynamic LTPO AMOLED 2X, 120Hz, HDR10+, 2600 nits (peak), 6.7 inches, 101.5 cm2 (~85.5% screen-to-body ratio), 1080 x 2640 pixels, 21.9:9 ratio (~426 ppi density)

Cameras.Rear camera: 50 MP, f/1.8, 23 mm (wide), 1/1.57", 1.0 μm, dual pixel PDAF, OIS, 12 MP, f/2.2, 13 mm, 123° (ultrawide), 1/3.2", 1.12 μm, LED flash, HDR, panorama, 4K@30/60fps, 1080p@60/120/240fps, 720p@960fps, HDR10+

Battery.Charging: 25W wired, QC2.0, 50% in 30 min, 15W wireless, 4.5W reverse wireless

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/6e, tri-band, Wi-Fi Direct, Bluetooth 5.4, A2DP, LE, GPS, GALILEO, GLONASS, BDS, QZSS, NFC, USB Type-C 3.2
